chunks.title: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG) (MUFG) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG) is a Global Commercial Bank headquartered in Japan. At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: Major Japanese megabank delegation at COP31 Antalya active in global renewable project finance & industrial transition. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: ¥100 trillion (~$650B+) cumulative sustainable finance target (FY2019–FY2030) spanning renewable project finance, hydrogen/ammonia & transition loans. Source verification: https://countercurrents.org/2026/11/climate-summit-to-save-the-planet-yet-polluters-crowd-the-halls-103-polluting-entities-at-cop31-2-2-trillion-in-fossil-fuel-financing/.

chunks.title: MUFG Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG) provides the following climate financing instruments: Renewable Project Finance Debt, Transition Loan, Green Bond Underwriting, Export Credit Agency (ECA)-Backed Green Loan. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 20,000,000 to USD 500,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Large Corporate, Project SPV, Financial Intermediary.

chunks.title: MUFG Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG): Renewable Energy, Industrial Decarbonization, Hydrogen & Sustainable Fuels, Electrification & Grid, Energy Storage. Target geographic focus includes: Global, Asia-Pacific, EMEA, Türkiye, Americas, Europe. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: MUFG Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete MUFG's application form: MUFG Environmental and Social Policy Framework & Equator Principles; Transition Finance eligibility (METI / ICMA Climate Transition Finance Handbook); Long-term PPA / EPC bankability & DSCR profile; External SPO or transition verification. Explicit exclusion rules: New unabated coal-fired power plants. Official application portal: https://www.mufg.jp/english/csr/sustainable_finance/index.html.

chunks.title: MUFG Form Template: Global Corporate & Investment Bank Green / Sustainability-Linked Finance Mandate Intake
chunks.text: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG) uses the 'Global Corporate & Investment Bank Green / Sustainability-Linked Finance Mandate Intake' workflow governed by LMA/APLMA Green Loan Principles (GLP), Sustainability-Linked Loan Principles (SLLP) & ICMA GBP. Typical review timeline is 3–8 weeks (Sustainable Finance Structuring -> Credit Committee -> Syndication/Close). Form sections required: 1. Borrower Overview, 2. Structuring, 3. Transition Credibility, 4. Risk & Underwriting, 5. Mandate Pitch.
